title: ObjectGenericDAE: the Jacobians of the algebraic equations and the constant terms in its equations
author: Claude-JG
description: The equations of ObjectGenericDAE write C_q^T lambda and C_y^T lambda with the matrices C_q and C_y of the linear term of the algebraic equations, while the solver adds the reaction terms from the Jacobian of the algebraic equations, which includes the derivatives of the constraintUserFunction; the constant terms are f and g beside c_0. Decided: the Jacobians C_q^* = C_q + dc_u/dq and C_y^* = C_y + dc_u/dy in the reaction terms, the matrices without a constraintUserFunction; the constant terms f_0, g_0 and c_0.
releaseNotes: The equations of ObjectGenericDAE write the reaction terms with the Jacobians of the algebraic equations, C_q^* = C_q + dc_u/dq and C_y^* = C_y + dc_u/dy, and the constant terms f_0, g_0 and c_0.
